profile.headline: Senior Software Developer, AI/ML and DevOps Engineer at INSHIFT
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Developer/Data Scientist/AI-ML & DevOps Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Developer/Data Scientist/AI-ML & DevOps Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Designed and implemented zero trust data security service applications deployed on Kubernetes (K8s) and OpenShift
Deployed infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible; managed applications with Helm Charts
Developed and deployed microservices in AWS using EC2, S3, Lambda, and Docker
Built secure data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Apache NiFi, Kafka, and custom ETL solutions
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and Jenkins to automate testing and deployment across environments
Applied Python and Bash for automation of operational tasks and infrastructure monitoring
Integrated system components with machine learning platforms for real-time analytics and intelligent insights

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed full cloud stack solutions and automated deployments using AWS CloudFormation
Designed and deployed ETL processes supporting data analysis for mission-critical intelligence applications
Resolved complex integration and operational issues related to large-scale data processing systems

positions.title: Software Engineer/Data Integrator
positions.description:
Optimized data ingestion platforms to handle increasing data volume and complexity
Managed data pipelines supporting multiple mission datasets and formats
Developed quality assurance standards for cross-database validation and integrity

positions.title: Operations Analyst
positions.locationName: Crystal City, Virginia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Conducted simulations and modeling for system effectiveness and mission-level analytics.
Built tools for constructive and virtual simulation environments.

positions.title: Systems Engineer/Integration Specialist
positions.description:
Led simulator and modeling development projects supporting classified satellite and defense systems.
Designed and validated spacecraft control systems software and supported launch/missions.
